data.name: Jilaatoon
data.gender_notes: Jilaatoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jilaatoon is a beautiful Arabic name for girls meaning gentle flowers. It is derived from the Arabic root word 'jilat' which means 'gentle' or 'soft', and the word 'toon' meaning 'flowers'. This name conveys a sense of grace, tenderness, and elegance. It is perfect for a little girl who embodies these qualities. The name Jilaatoon carries the meaning “Gentle Flowers” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jilaatoon usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle flowers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jilaatoon is a name that symbolizes the gentle nature of Allah (SWT). It reminds us of the beauty and tenderness of the natural world, and the importance of treating all living beings with kindness and compassion.
data.etymology: Jilaatoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle Flowers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jilaatoon total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
